name: acryl-state
description: Observable cells and derived cells, shared state with JSON, server-sent event and WebSocket routes on the router, and a browser module (watch) that follows keys over one socket. Vendored from ACRYL.
mount: root.plugin(state); ctx.state.cell('todos.count', 0), then count.update((n) => n + 1); a page follows it with import { watch } from '/api/state/client.js'; watch('todos.count', (n) => { ... })
